name: hacocoon-agent-workspaces
description: Create isolated Hacocoon worktrees and Environments for VS Code coding-agent sessions.

hacocoon.agentWorkspace.gitExecutable.description: Git executable inside the Hacocoon execution host. Commands are executed without a shell.

hacocoon.agentWorkspace.adapterExecutabl.description: haco-agent-host executable inside the Hacocoon execution host.

hacocoon.agentWorkspace.worktreeRoot.description: Absolute Linux root for VS Code-created linked worktrees. Empty uses a .hacocoon-worktrees directory beside the repository.

hacocoon.agentWorkspace.wslDistro.description: WSL distribution used from Windows to run Git and haco-agent-host.

hacocoon.agentWorkspace.repositoryPath.description: Optional absolute Linux repository path inside the configured WSL distribution. If empty, a matching Remote-WSL workspace path is reused or VS Code prompts for a path.
